youtube_title: Why Checking Your SIP Daily Costs You 📉 #Shorts
youtube_description:
Guess why checking your SIP every day makes you lose money?

A loss hurts about 2x more than the same gain feels good (loss aversion, Kahneman & Tversky). Check daily and you see red on lots of days, so you panic, pause the SIP and sell at the bottom. Economists Benartzi & Thaler call it myopic loss aversion.

Rule: check your SIP once a month or once a quarter. Remove the widget. Let time work.
Moral: Check less, panic less.

Sources: Tversky & Kahneman (1992); Benartzi & Thaler (1995).
Education only, not investment advice.
